interpretations: For each player with a nonempty, non-NULL batting hand, average their non-NULL `batting_postseason.double` values across records. Divide that average by the mean of those per-player averages across eligible players. Subtract the mean index of players with the same batting hand, then return the 10 largest differences with the requested columns, unrounded and with missing values last
queries:
WITH player_averages AS (
    SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles
    FROM player AS p
    LEFT JOIN batting_postseason AS bp
        ON bp.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(p.bats) <> ''
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
),
player_indexes AS (
    SELECT player_id, bats,
           avg_doubles / NULLIF(AVG(avg_doubles) OVER (), 0) AS batting_index
    FROM player_averages
),
differences AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           batting_index - AVG(batting_index) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference
    FROM player_indexes
)
SELECT player_id, difference
FROM differences
ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
